topics.title: Schema Definition (CREATE, ALTER, DROP) & Primary Keys
topics.objective: Define normalized relational schemas with primary keys, foreign keys, and unique constraints.
topics.example: CREATE TABLE users (id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, email VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE NOT NULL);
topics.exercise: Design an e-commerce schema with users, orders, items, and foreign key relationships.

topics.title: Basic Querying (SELECT, WHERE, ORDER BY, LIMIT)
topics.objective: Retrieve filtered and ordered datasets using predicate operators and pagination limits.
topics.example: SELECT name, price FROM products WHERE price > 50.0 ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 10;
topics.exercise: Write queries to find active customers registered in the last 30 days.

topics.title: Relational Joins (INNER, LEFT, RIGHT, FULL OUTER)
topics.objective: Combine normalized tables using foreign key relationships and handle null rows safely.
topics.example: SELECT o.id, u.email FROM orders o INNER JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.id;
topics.exercise: Generate a customer order summary including customers who have never placed an order.

topics.title: Aggregations & Grouping (GROUP BY, HAVING, Window Functions)
topics.objective: Compute summary statistics, grouped summaries, and row-level ranking analytics.
topics.example: SELECT department, AVG(salary) FROM employees GROUP BY department HAVING COUNT(*) > 5;
topics.exercise: Compute month-over-month revenue growth using window functions (SUM OVER and LAG).

topics.title: Indexing, EXPLAIN Query Planning & Performance Optimization
topics.objective: Analyze execution plans, identify sequential table scans, and create targeted B-Tree indexes.
topics.example: EXPLAIN ANALYZE SELECT * FROM logs WHERE created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day';
topics.exercise: Optimize an underperforming query on a million-row table using composite indexing.
